EMPTY_BODY.description: PR description is empty or minimal placeholder

TEMPLATE_UNFILLED.description: Required checklist items unchecked or section placeholders untouched

TRIVIAL_DOCS_EDIT.description: Only README/docs changed with <= 3 lines altered

WHITESPACE_ONLY.description: Diff contains only whitespace, indentation, or blank line alterations

GENERIC_TITLE.description: PR title matches generic default patterns (e.g. 'Update README.md')

NO_LINKED_ISSUE.description: No issue reference or ticket link detected in description

ADDS_SELF_PROMO_LINK.description: Modifies contributors/links list only to add self-reference

replyTemplates.NEEDS_INFO: Thanks for opening this! To help us investigate and reproduce this effectively, could you please provide: {missingInfo}? This will help us identify the root cause faster.
replyTemplates.POSSIBLE_DUPLICATE: Thanks for reporting this! This appears similar to {duplicates}. Could you please review those and check if they address what you are experiencing?
replyTemplates.PR_NEEDS_DESCRIPTION: Thank you for the pull request! Could you please add a short description explaining what problem this PR solves and link any relevant issue? Thanks!
replyTemplates.PR_LOW_EFFORT: Thanks for contributing! It looks like this pull request contains very minor changes without description. Please review our contributing guidelines to see how you can make a more meaningful impact.
